- [USER] The user wants to make a list of facial expressions/emotions to classify emotions seen in photographs of people.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a list of common facial expressions and emotions, including: Happy, Sad, Angry, Surprised, Fearful, Disgusted, Confused, Calm, Contempt, Excited, Tired, Pensive, Joyful, Relaxed, Bored, Amused, Anxious, Ashamed, Interested, Pleased.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that the list is not exhaustive and that different cultures and individuals may express emotions differently.
- [USER] The user inquired if it is possible to link facial expressions with descriptive words for the physical expressions associated with those emotions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant confirmed that it is possible and provided a detailed list linking emotions with physical expressions, including:
  - Happy: Smiling, relaxed eyes, raised cheeks, wrinkles around the eyes.
  - Sad: Furrowed brow, downturned mouth, droopy eyelids, tears.
  - Angry: Furrowed brow, scowling, clenched jaw, tight lips, flared nostrils.
  - Surprised: Raised eyebrows, widened eyes, open mouth.
  - Fearful: Wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open mouth, tense jaw.
  - Disgusted: Curled lip, wrinkled nose, raised eyebrows.
  - Confused: Furrowed brow, squinted eyes, tilted head.
  - Calm: Relaxed face, neutral expression.
  - Contempt: One corner of the mouth raised, often with a raised eyebrow.
  - Excited: Wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open mouth, flushed cheeks.
  - Tired: Droopy eyelids, wrinkles around the eyes, sagging face.
  - Pensive: Furrowed brow, squinted eyes, tilted head, puckered lips.
  - Joyful: Smiling, relaxed eyes, raised cheeks, wrinkles around the eyes.
  - Relaxed: Soft eyes, slight smile, relaxed jaw.
  - Bored: Furrowed brow, squinted eyes, tilted head, puckered lips.
  - Amused: Smiling, relaxed eyes, wrinkles around the eyes.
  - Anxious: Furrowed brow, tight lips, tense jaw, fidgeting.
  - Ashamed: Downcast eyes, furrowed brow, downturned mouth, flushed cheeks.
  - Interested: Raised eyebrows, widened eyes, leaned forward.
  - Pleased: Smiling, relaxed eyes, wrinkles around the eyes, a slight nod of the head.
